ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the ongoing federal investigations into misconduct and fraud in Minnesota, with a focus on following the money trail to uncover the extent of the issue.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and hold those responsible accountable. By following the money trail and conducting thorough research, we can shed light on the issue and provide valuable insights to the public.
